Tara (People Ops): Final call  were launching handbook v3 localized pages next Tue. Main items: updated parental leave tables for UK/IE, tighter expense caps, and an EU data processing blurb. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/v3-local
Ben (HR Ops): Quick Q: are managers required to acknowledge the localized changes or just employees?
Tara (People Ops): Managers must acknowledge (simple e-sign) and attend a 20-min manager-only walkthrough. Well capture confirmations in the sheet: https://sheets.goo.gl/rwdv3-acks
Ines (EMEA Partner): Ill review the UK/IE tables. Heads up: DE needs a statutory phrase for data-processing; Noah can you drop recommended wording?
Noah (Legal): Yep  I added a suggested sentence under section 6.2 and a short FAQ bullet for expense caps. Will push final phrasing by EOD.
TrackerBot: Update: 4/52 managers confirmed, 0 sessions full. Use /rsvp in invites.
Ben (HR Ops): Scheduling manager walkthroughs: Mon 0830 UTC (EMEA), Tue 1700 UTC (US overlap), Wed 0100 UTC (APAC). 20 min each, recordings posted.
Tara (People Ops): Manager checklist (paste into sheet):
```
- Confirm localized section with regional partner
- Complete manager e-sign ack
- Share recording with your team within 48h
- Flag any JD updates for hiring ops
```
Ines (EMEA Partner): I'll sign off on DE once legal's statutory copy is in. Also can run a quick sweep of open reqs in EMEA for legacy benefit language.
Ben (HR Ops): Hiring ops heads: please grep active JDs for "parental" and "relocation" and tag me if numbers need updating. Hold new postings until JDs are aligned.
Noah (Legal): Note: expense cap tightening requires a one-line FAQ on reimbursable categories. Dropping 3 bullets in the doc now.
TrackerBot: Ack stats: 4 confirmed, 28 pending, 20 unassigned. Reminders scheduled 48h before deadline.
Tara (People Ops): Final deadline for manager confirms: next Fri 18:00 UTC. If you cant make a live slot, RSVP and well assign a recording + 1:1. Ill post a short summary in #general 24h before publish. :sparkles:
